translations.contact-page.hero.lede: A question about the platform, a quote for your company, a partnership: write to us and a founder reads it. Replies go out within one working day.
translations.contact-page.form.title: Write to us
translations.contact-page.form.body: Tell us what you are building and where you are stuck. The more concrete the message, the more useful the answer.
translations.contact-page.sent.title: Your message is on its way
translations.contact-page.sent.body: We read every message ourselves. Expect a reply within one working day, at the address you gave.
translations.contact-page.field.name: Your name
translations.contact-page.field.subject: What about
translations.contact-page.form.note: We use your address to reply, and for nothing else.
translations.contact-page.faq.title: Asked before you
translations.contact-page.cta.title: Or skip the conversation
translations.contact-page.cta.body: Creating a project and seeing what IDEM produces costs nothing, and takes about as long as writing this message.
translations.contact-page.channel.email.label: Email
translations.contact-page.channel.email.detail: The fastest route. A founder reads it.
translations.contact-page.channel.phone.label: Phone and WhatsApp
translations.contact-page.channel.office.label: Office
translations.contact-page.channel.office.detail: Come by if you are in town — tell us first.
translations.contact-page.channel.code.label: Issues and code
translations.contact-page.channel.code.detail: A bug or a feature request belongs here, in the open.
translations.contact-page.faq.delay.question: How long until someone replies?
translations.contact-page.faq.delay.answer: One working day for a written message. If it is urgent, call the number above — it rings on a founder's phone.
translations.contact-page.faq.enterprise.question: Can IDEM run inside my company?
translations.contact-page.faq.enterprise.answer: Yes. The licence lets you install the whole platform on your own servers, for your own company. Tell us your constraints and we will say what it takes.
translations.contact-page.faq.payment.question: How do I pay from my country?
translations.contact-page.faq.payment.answer: Mobile Money in thirteen African countries, or card. The wallet is topped up in CFA francs and spent as you generate.
translations.contact-page.faq.support.question: What help comes with a paid plan?
translations.contact-page.faq.support.answer: Written support by email, priority on paid plans, and the documentation. Nothing is hidden behind a support contract.
translations.contact-page.faq.reseller.question: I build sites for clients. Can I resell IDEM?
translations.contact-page.faq.reseller.answer: Agencies and consultants work with us already. Write with the kind of clients you serve and we will set the terms together.
translations.contact-page.error.incomplete: Name, email, subject and message are needed before we can reply.
translations.contact-page.error.network: The message did not go through. Try again, or write straight to contact@idem.africa.
